d: Minister Rajmohan accused the previous DMK government of orchestrating India's first Artificial Intelligence scam in public library book procurement. Addressing the press, he produced documents including purchase orders, committee minutes, and payment vouchers from February and March 2026. He stated that bogus, AI-generated titles under fabricated author names were procured through Agal Vilakku publishing house for the Coimbatore Periyar Arivulagam and other regional libraries. Commending writer Perumal Murugan for whistleblowing on the issue, Rajmohan demanded an unconditional apology…
